_doc: Corrections applied on top of Missale Meum output. Each entry replaces the row for that date. Rank and colour are read from the observance id (…:<rank>:<colour>). Report each upstream and delete it once fixed there.

2027-03-19.reason: St Joseph (class I) falls on Friday of Passion Week. Missale Meum's rule_seven_sorrows_on_friday_after_passion_sunday returns before precedence is checked, so the class III feria wins. Rubricae generales 1960: a class I feast outranks a class III Lenten feria, which is commemorated.
